name: quiz-diplom
description: Онлайн-квиз: TV-экран + PWA игроков, NestJS и WebSocket

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @quiz/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,tv,player -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @quiz/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @quiz/api" "npm run dev -w @quiz/tv" "npm run dev -w @quiz/player"
scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && node -e "setTimeout(()=>process.exit(0), 4000)" && npm run prisma:deploy -w @quiz/api && npm run prisma:seed -w @quiz/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @quiz/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
